title: Client scheduling policy
description: Policy rules the scheduling engines consume, one document per client. Defaults in the example documents reproduce behaviour as of 2026-09-22: poetic.json matches scheduling-worker/ (the tracker engine), luminai.json matches candidate-dashboard on feature/client-ashby-connection. null means that engine does not enforce the rule. No engine reads these files yet; until one does, editing them changes nothing. Coordinator-editable data (partner roster, identities, tracker assignments, desks, laptops, working hours) is deliberately out of scope.
$comment: Deliberately absent: breaks/buffers (row 19), Ashby meeting hours (row 30) and bookable-over event types (row 32). Each needs new engine logic, not just config, and row 32 also needs client sign-off before any code, because it requires wider Google Calendar access than the current free/busy-only connection. additionalProperties is false throughout so these cannot be added to a document ahead of that work.

clientId.description: Matches SCHEDULING_CLIENT_ID on the dashboard; the tracker hardcodes "poetic".

rulesRevision.description: Increment on every change. Engines should include it in each plan's digest, as they already do with templateRevision, so an approval made under older rules can no longer book.

stageTitleContains.description: Row 7. Case-insensitive substring identifying the work-trial stage. Today: /work trial/i in ashby-provider.js, plus copies in bots/ashby-panel.config.js and bots/pool-health.config.js.

maxDaysAfterStart.description: Row 5. Latest end date as days after the start date. Today diffDays(start, end) <= 14, which allows up to 15 calendar days counting both ends.

roles.description: Row 6. Valid trial roles (proposal.js validatePlan, assignment-inventory.js ROLES).

jobTitleToRole.description: Row 6. Ashby job title to role, case-insensitive substring, first match wins (bots/ashby-panel.config.js positions). Each role should appear in trial.roles; JSON Schema cannot check that, so the loader must.

maxConcurrentTrialsPerDay.description: Row 1. Total trials allowed on one day, including the one being proposed. Today 2: the proposal is blocked when 2 other trials already occupy a day (proposal.js capacityIssues).

sameRoleSameDay.description: Row 2. What happens when another trial of the same role is on the same day.

minReasonChars.description: Minimum trimmed length of the approver's override reason.

bypassCandidateName.description: Row 4. Candidates whose tracker name matches skip every capacity check (pilot bypass in ashby-provider.js).

exclusions.description: Rows 8 and 9, merged. Matching is always case-insensitive and ignores surrounding spaces. appliesTo keeps today's three separate uses: trialDate = never sets the trial date (bots/pre-trial-sessions.config.js via lib/trialwindow.js); shadowMilestone = shown as the shadowing milestone (bots/ashby-panel.config.js agentShadowTitleContains; only meaningful together with trialDate); fullTrialProposal = left out when the scheduler proposes a Full Work Trial (ashby-provider.js).

singleDay.description: Row 24. The whole agenda must fall on one candidate-local date. The dashboard enforces this only in full-calendar-schedule.js, which no route calls yet; the tracker never checks it.

fallbackMinutes.description: Row 21. Duration used when Ashby's plan gives none. null means refuse the plan instead.
fallbackMinutes.$comment: The two engines diverge here, and the divergence is probably accidental. The tracker silently uses 45 minutes (ashby-provider.js) while the dashboard refuses a session with a missing or invalid duration. Refusing is safer: a guessed duration can book the wrong length and push every later session. Poetic keeps 45 only to preserve today's behaviour; the intended end state is null for every client.

minMinutes.description: Row 21. Shortest accepted session. The dashboard refuses anything under 5.

maxMinutes.description: Row 21. Longest accepted session. The dashboard refuses anything over 480.

strategy.description: Row 17. How to choose between eligible interviewers. lowest_confirmed_load is the tracker's planner.js, which only tests use; fewest_in_agenda is live in the dashboard's agenda previews.

ashbyInterviewerLimits.description: Row 18. Use of Ashby's per-interviewer dailyLimit/weeklyLimit. zero_only = a limit of 0 blocks suggestions (live on the dashboard today); enforce = full counting, which exists only in solvers nothing calls yet.

source.description: Row 31. Where interviewer busy time comes from. Missing data is always busy; that stays in code.

calendars.description: Row 31. Which of each interviewer's calendars block time. Today only the primary calendar is read; the handoff notes extra blocking calendars are not.

ashbyConflictsAdvisory.description: Row 31. Also show the conflicts Ashby displays on a saved draft, as advice only. A missing conflict never counts as free.

calendarInvitesRequired.description: Row 40. A booking is not marked scheduled until calendar invitations are verified as sent.

candidateConfirmationRequired.description: Row 40. A candidate confirmation email must be part of the plan and verified as sent (booking-engine.js).

policy.description: Row 42. required_when_session_flagged = a session marked requiresRoom must have a room (tracker proposal.js); validate_if_present = there is no requiresRoom concept, but any room given must have an id and an invited email (dashboard booking-engine.js). Nothing supplies rooms today.

approvers.description: Row 36. Who may approve proposals and bookings. Identities only: passwords and other credentials never go in this file. Today the tracker reads Postgres users.can_approve (seeded from users.js; revocations made in the database are not undone by the seed), and the dashboard reads usernames from SCHEDULING_APPROVERS_JSON.

kind.description: email = tracker sign-in identity; username = dashboard basic-auth approver account.

shared.description: true when the account is used by more than one person, so an approval does not identify an individual.

allowedDomain.description: Row 36. Email domain required to sign in (users.js ALLOWED_DOMAIN). null where the engine has no such check.
